package fixture

import "strings"

// Ordinary Go that must not trip the rule. Every one of these starts with an authorization verb
// and continues into something that has nothing to do with permission — if the gate fired on these
// it would be waived everywhere within a week, which is the same as being switched off.
func hasPrefix(s string) bool  { return strings.HasPrefix(s, "x") }
func canRetry(n int) bool      { return n < 3 }
func isReady() bool            { return true }
func validateName(s string) error { return nil }
func checkSum(b []byte) int    { return len(b) }
